title: Vehicle Scrapping
shortDescription: End-to-end scrapping for all vehicle types, compliant with government norms.
description: Our core service covers the complete scrapping lifecycle — from inspection and valuation to certified dismantling. Every vehicle is processed at our government-authorized facility using standardized recovery protocols that maximize material reclamation while meeting environmental compliance requirements.

title: RC Cancellation
shortDescription: We manage full RTO documentation to cancel your vehicle registration.
description: Cancelling a Registration Certificate can be a bureaucratic maze. Our documentation specialists handle every RTO interaction on your behalf, ensuring your vehicle is legally deregistered and you're protected from future liability, fines, or challans tied to the old registration.

title: Pollution Certificate
shortDescription: Assistance in acquiring and closing pollution clearance records.
description: We assist owners in resolving outstanding Pollution Under Control certificate records as part of the scrapping process, ensuring your vehicle's environmental compliance history is properly closed out alongside its deregistration.

title: Insurance Assistance
shortDescription: Guidance on cancelling policies and claiming applicable refunds.
description: Our advisors help you navigate insurance policy cancellation once your vehicle is scrapped, including guidance on pro-rata refund eligibility and the paperwork insurers require to process it.

title: Buy Back Service
shortDescription: We purchase old vehicles in any condition at fair market value.
description: Whether your vehicle runs or not, our buy-back program offers a straightforward path to converting it into cash. We evaluate based on transparent, weight and material-based pricing models — no negotiation games.

title: Corporate Fleet Disposal
shortDescription: Structured, compliant disposal programs for enterprise vehicle fleets.
description: We partner with corporates and government departments to manage large-scale fleet decommissioning — coordinating logistics, batch documentation, and reporting across multiple vehicles and locations simultaneously.

title: Commercial Vehicle Scrapping
shortDescription: Specialized dismantling for trucks, buses and heavy vehicles.
description: Commercial vehicles require specialized equipment and higher-capacity dismantling lines. We handle trucks, buses, and heavy transport vehicles with the infrastructure needed to process them safely and efficiently.

title: Auction Assistance
shortDescription: Support for institutions liquidating vehicles through auction routes.
description: For government bodies and institutions required to dispose of vehicles via auction, we provide end-to-end support — from valuation benchmarking to post-auction scrapping and documentation for the winning process.
